SECURITY POLICY**

| **Document ID**      | IT-POL-002                                     |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| **Department**       | IT                                             |
| **Document Type**    | Policy                                         |

| **Version**          | 2026                                           |
| **Effective Date**   | 01-Apr-2026                                    |

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: This policy establishes information security and access-control requirements for organizational accounts, authentication, remote access, provisioning, modification, revocation, and incident reporting.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: This policy applies to employees, contractors where applicable, organizational systems, accounts, devices, and information resources.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: IT provisions organizational access after receiving an authorized request containing employee ID, department, role, required systems, and manager approval.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: Organizational accounts must use approved authentication controls. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required where supported and designated by IT standards.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: Users must protect credentials, use approved password practices, and never share authentication credentials with other individuals.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: When an employee changes role or responsibilities, access privileges must be reviewed and modified according to the employee's new business requirements.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: During offboarding, IT disables organizational system access by the employee's final working day, subject to documented security or operational requirements.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: Remote work must use company-approved devices, secure authentication, MFA where required, and approved network/security controls. Organizational credentials must not be shared.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: Suspected security incidents must be reported to the IT Service Desk or designated IT security channel as soon as reasonably possible. IT coordinates technical investigation and containment.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: Employees must protect organizational information, follow security controls, report incidents, and use systems only for authorized purposes.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: Managers provide accurate role and authorization information. HR provides relevant employee lifecycle information. IT manages provisioning, modification, revocation, and technical security controls.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: Exceptions require documented justification, risk consideration, and applicable IT/security approval.

metadata.policy_title: Information Security and Access Control Policy

text: 2025 — Initial policy issued. 2026 — Access lifecycle, MFA, remote access, and incident reporting requirements updated.
